lines.en: label ramengen:
scene firsttsuneyoramen1
I head to Tojo Ramen to grab a quick bite to eat and chat with Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: 我去 Tojo Ramen 随便吃点东西，顺便跟 Tsuneyo 聊聊天。

lines.en: Under most circumstances, I'd avoid going all the way across town just for food.
lines.zh: 在大多数情况下，我不会为了吃顿饭而横穿整个镇子。

lines.en: But something about this place just keeps pulling me back.
lines.zh: 可这地方有某种东西，一直把我拉回来。

lines.en: I'm not sure if it's the broth or...the strange conversations to be had with the self-proclaimed 'Samurai of Flavor,' but I really {i}do{/i} enjoy my time here.
lines.zh: 我不知道那是汤底，还是……和那位自称「风味武士」的女孩之间那些古怪的对话，但我{i}真的{/i}很享受在这儿的时间。

lines.en: I just wish it wasn't so far away.
lines.zh: 我只是希望它别这么远。

lines.en: scene black
I stay for another thirty minutes or so after finishing my meal and Tsuneyo tells me more stories about her childhood.
lines.zh: 吃完之后我又待了三十分钟左右，Tsuneyo 给我讲了更多她小时候的故事。

lines.en: I'd like to say that they're normal or wholesome stories, but the fact is that everything she tells me is rather weird...
lines.zh: 我倒想说那些是正常、温情的故事，可事实是，她告诉我的每一件事都相当古怪……

lines.en: I chalk it up to her just being born strange and decide to head home after sliding some money across the table, leaving a generous tip behind.
lines.zh: 我把这归结于她天生就奇怪，然后在把钱推过桌子、留下一笔丰厚的小费之后，决定回家。

lines.en: : I can't accept this. It is not culturally acceptable.
lines.zh: : 我不能收。这在文化上说不通。

lines.en: : Just take my fucking money, Tsuneyo.
: Ah-
Tsuneyo reluctantly nods in appreciation and parts with an expectedly formal goodbye...
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 不情愿地点头表示感谢，然后用一句意料之中的正式告别送我离开……
